notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two doors of the upper cabinet are reported separately because each is independently hinged and opened; their individual closing midpoints are close together and somewhat uncertain due to the 8-frame sampling interval.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a narrow residential kitchen. The user opens and closes a wide food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes both hinged doors of the cabinet above the range hood, and then opens and closes a utensil-and-wrap drawer beside the stove.
